topic: Tech neck: is it just posture?
caption:
Neck and shoulders locked up by the end of the day? 🐢
Tech neck is often less about one 'bad posture' and more about how long you stay in any position.

✔ Raise your screen
✔ Move every 30–40 min
✔ Try chin tucks

If it lingers or you notice arm pins and needles, book an assessment with a physio.
